title: Recorded FLOPs are assigned to every selected kernel in msprof MFU
mechanism: At msprof-analyze revision 639eb8702c1884813dfab59ddb371f7838caab6d, MFUCalculator joins CPU-op/kernel correlation with kernel shapes on kernel_name, kernel_ts and kernel_end. A recorded MSTX FLOPs range selects op_ts with the closed condition startNs <= op_ts <= endNs, then drops duplicate kernel_ts/kernel_end pairs. The sum of task_duration is only a positivity gate. Dtype is taken from the first selected row before non-positive task durations are removed. Each remaining kernel receives the entire recorded range FLOPs, using flops / (task_duration * 1e-9) / chip_peak. FLOPs are not divided among the selected kernels. The 1e-9 conversion belongs to this database path; it does not inherit the separate CSV column label Task Duration(us). This source reading establishes the attribution formula, not a measured hardware-utilization result. Exporter schemas and clock definitions remain outside the admitted source set.
corrections: Keep the inclusive point-selection predicate and full-range FLOPs attribution explicit.
Do not describe total_duration as a per-kernel FLOPs weighting.
Keep database timing units separate from the other analyzer's CSV labels.
source_scope: Root accepted only the rewritten mechanism. Independent Cursor reading and its broader findings remain in the immutable author packet. Root source reading is enumerated separately.
adoption_boundary: Use to interpret an MFU table only after checking the actual exporter clock, dtype and FLOPs-range semantics. No NPU execution or measured efficiency is established here.
